steps.user_message: I had a great time at the art gallery opening last night with my cousin Emily, exploring all the new exhibits together.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I had a great time at the art gallery opening last night with my cousin Emily, exploring all the new exhibits together.
steps.agent_response:
That sounds lovely — glad you had a good time. Would you like help turning that into an email or message? I can draft or send a thank-you to Emily, a follow-up to the gallery, or a social post. Here are a few quick templates you can use — tell me which one you want and whether to send or save as a draft (and provide Emily’s email or any photos/attachments if you want them included).

1) Short & casual (text/email to Emily)
- Subject: Great time last night!
- Body: Hi Emily — I had such a great time at the gallery last night. Loved exploring the new exhibits with you — especially [favorite piece/room]. Let’s do it again soon! — [Your name]

2) Friendly, with details + plan
- Subject: Loved the gallery — want to grab coffee this weekend?
- Body: Hey Emily — I had a fantastic time at the opening last night. I can’t stop thinking about the [artist/name or piece] — such an interesting use of [color/material]. If you’re free this weekend, want to meet for coffee and talk about our favorites? — [Your name]

3) Short note to the gallery (feedback)
- Subject: Thank you for a wonderful opening
- Body: Hello — I attended last night’s opening and wanted to say how much I enjoyed the exhibits, particularly the works by [artist]. The curation and atmosphere were excellent. Thank you for hosting a fantastic event. Best, [Your name]

If you want, I can:
- Draft one now and save to drafts
- Send it (I’ll need the recipient address)
- Include photos or tag specific exhibits/artists
Which would you like me to do?
